name: World Canvas / Scene Bank Contract
canonicalRule: Exterior overworld scenes use canonical generated geography in Game Canvas. Interior, cave, dungeon, and special scenes are indexed by the Scene Library and open as Game Canvas scene documents; the library is not a parallel world or camera canvas.

overworldCanvas.selection: Click canonical generated landmass geography to select the corresponding authored/world document; preview rectangles are compatibility-only.
overworldCanvas.legacyPreviewCompatibility: SceneRectangleSpec.world_rect_preview_px may be read by legacy tools but never positions complete-world geography in Game Canvas.

sceneBank.connectionModel: Transitions link overworld rectangles to off-world scene-bank scenes.
sceneBank.selection: Click a Scene Bank card or list row to select an off-world scene document.
sceneBank.openAction: Enter, inspector action, or selected card opens the scene as a Game Canvas scene document.
sceneBank.cameraAuthority: none; Scene Library is screen-space collection UI and never owns CanvasCameraState

currentLimitations: Arbitrary new scene creation still requires replacing remaining enum-backed starter IDs with fully project-owned serializable IDs.
Scene Library cards do not yet expose every transition/duplicate/delete workflow inline.
